scope: Puerto Williams urban services: drinking water and sanitation, waste and recycling, municipal services, and basic commercial supply context
source_priority: Delegacion Presidencial Provincial de la Antartica Chilena
Gobierno Regional de Magallanes y de la Antartica Chilena
historical municipal/tourism documents only as context

claims.claim: The Rio Robalo basin supplies drinking water to Puerto Williams.
claims.retrieval_rule: Do not infer water quality or uninterrupted supply from source identity alone.

claims.claim: Aguas Magallanes operates and maintains drinking-water production, distribution and wastewater collection services in Puerto Williams under a collaboration/operation arrangement documented by the company.
claims.note: The operator relationship is supported, but the exact legal/contractual arrangement and current service metrics should be refreshed from newer Aguas Magallanes or SISS documentation before legal or regulatory publication.

claims.claim: In 2026 authorities were prioritizing a master sanitation plan for Puerto Williams, including drinking-water and sewerage infrastructure improvements.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not state that the master plan has already been completed or that all urban sectors currently have upgraded water/sewerage infrastructure.

claims.claim: Puerto Williams experienced a drinking-water supply emergency in 2024 after problems at the Rio Robalo intake; official testing later confirmed water suitable for human consumption before normal service resumed.
claims.retrieval_rule: Use only as resilience/history context. Never answer current water-quality questions from this 2024 event.

claims.claim: The Municipality of Cabo de Hornos currently maintains an environmental/recycling layer with mapped recycling containers and points for materials including oils.
claims.retrieval_rule: Container locations and collection operation require recheck before route-level recommendations.

claims.claim: A municipal/community organic-waste composting initiative in Cabo de Hornos was implemented with Ministry of the Environment support, including household containers and municipal collection/composting workflow.
claims.note: Do not assume 2026 collection frequency or program coverage from the original implementation article.

claims.claim: The Municipality of Cabo de Hornos provides current municipal services from Puerto Williams and publishes current directories, environmental functions, municipal procedures and local development projects.
claims.retrieval_rule: Office contacts and hours must be rechecked before user-facing operational advice.

claims.claim: Puerto Williams has established local commercial activity and basic supply services, but the current corpus does not yet support a complete authoritative 2026 inventory of supermarkets, minimarkets, pharmacies or current stock conditions.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not reuse old lists of shops as a current 2026 commercial directory. Do not claim stock or opening hours without live first-party verification.

system_rules.water_quality: Current potability, outages, boil-water advice or emergency distribution must be checked live from Aguas Magallanes, health authority, municipality or provincial emergency authority.
system_rules.sanitation_projects: Planned sanitation infrastructure remains planned until official completion evidence is available.
system_rules.waste: Existence of recycling infrastructure does not prove current pickup frequency or container availability.
system_rules.commerce: Business existence, opening hours, inventory, payment acceptance and product availability are dynamic and must not be embedded as stable facts.
system_rules.travel_assistant: For practical trip questions, prefer a live-services layer over semantic embeddings for water incidents, waste collection, shopping hours and stock.

stable_context: Rio Robalo as drinking-water source context
